plugins.name: sitelemetry
plugins.description: Audit websites you own or are authorized to test for security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking, accessibility and performance, then turn the findings into prioritized fixes and re-test them.

skills.name: ai-visibility
skills.description: Use the Sitelemetry AI visibility (GEO/AEO) and technical SEO audits on a site the user owns to propose evidence-backed changes such as robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, schema.org JSON-LD structured data, an llms.txt file and content edits, each only where the findings support it. Use when the user asks how AI assistants and AI search can crawl, understand or cite their site, or wants to improve GEO, AEO or structured data.

skills.name: domain-verification
skills.description: Explain and help complete Sitelemetry ownership verification when an audit returns action_required because the target is not verified, the proof has expired, the target spelling differs from the verified one, or the proof does not cover host-wide checks. Covers the DNS TXT record, HTTP file and Google Search Console methods, then retries the same audit. Use when an audit asks for verification or the user asks how to verify their site.

skills.name: fix-and-retest
skills.description: Turn Sitelemetry audit findings into concrete fixes for the user's stack (nginx, Apache, Cloudflare, Vercel or Next.js, Netlify, WordPress), apply them with the user's approval or hand them over ready to use, then re-run the same audit on the same target and report honestly what is resolved, still open or not measured. Use after an audit when the user asks how to fix the findings, wants the changes made, or wants to confirm that a fix worked.

skills.name: pre-launch-check
skills.description: Run a pre-release check of a website the user owns with Sitelemetry security, performance and accessibility audits, plus technical SEO when the site is meant to be indexed, then summarise launch blockers versus warnings using only measured results. Use when the user is about to launch, deploy, go live, migrate or redesign a site and wants to know what must be fixed first.
headings: 2. Run the audits one at a time

skills.name: website-audit
skills.description: Run a Sitelemetry audit on a website the user owns or is authorized to test, wait correctly for long-running audits, and present the findings ranked by severity with the top fixes. Use when the user asks to audit, scan, check or score their own site for security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking, accessibility (WCAG) or performance (Core Web Vitals), or asks for an overall site health check.
